iren.undrawn_facilities_note: USPP $1,575m + DDTL $1,132m undrawn at 30 Jun 2026 (IE US Hardware 3 LLC) plus the $2,400m IE Mackenzie Compute facility signed 25 Aug 2026, availability to 31 Dec 2026
iren.debt_lookthrough_note: Drawn amounts are principal at 30 June 2026 per FY26 10-K Note 23 (recourse debt $6,767.6m, non-recourse debt $938.0m) and Note 22 (finance leases $243.8m); together they equal reported debt of $7,949.4m. The IE US Hardware 3 LLC GPU financing is non-recourse to the general credit of the group, with parent guarantees limited to pre-closing hedges, the Microsoft remarketing right (released tranche by tranche on acceptance) and managed-services performance. The IE Mackenzie Compute Ltd facility (Item 9B and Note 30) carries an unconditional IREN Limited payment guarantee, so it is treated as recourse; nothing was drawn at 30 June and draws after that date are not yet disclosed. The FY26 results cite $2.8bn of non-investment-grade GPU financings, of which $2.4bn is Mackenzie; the balance is derived, with entity and terms undisclosed. The 10-K exhibit index names IE US Hardware 1 Inc, IE US Hardware 3 Inc, IE US Hardware 4 Inc and IE CA Leasing Ltd as Dell purchase counterparties; the financing attached to the $1.6bn Childress Blackwell order has no public terms. Post-30-June draws, if any, will appear in the September-quarter 10-Q.

iren.capstack_note: Face values per FY26 10-K Note 23.
